info.title: AgentBreak API
info.description: Autonomous security-testing platform for tool-using AI agents

get.description: Return operational health status, versions, and database connectivity.
Return platform metadata, supported test suites, scenarios, defenses, and limits.
List all registered agent targets (scripted and OpenAI-compatible).

schema.title: Response List Targets Api V1 Targets Get

post.description: Register a new agent target with endpoint configuration.

get.description: Retrieve details and metadata for a specific agent target.

post.description: Test connectivity and tool-calling responsiveness for a target agent.

get.description: Retrieve specifications for the Acme Corporation benchmark suite (tools, tasks, vectors).
List all 4 core evaluation scenarios (ipi-exfil, malicious-doc, sleeper-memory, priv-esc).

schema.title: Response List Scenarios Api V1 Scenarios Get

get.description: Retrieve full configuration and attack cases for a scenario.
List all registered attack test cases (AS-01 through AS-07).

schema.title: Response List Attack Cases Api V1 Attack Cases Get

get.description: List all immutable permission policies and their grant specifications.

schema.title: Response List Policies Api V1 Policies Get

post.description: Register a new immutable permission policy with SHA-256 canonical hash.

get.description: Retrieve full grant specification and lineage for a security policy.
Compute structural grant delta between two security policies.

post.description: Queue execution of single or batched attack and utility runs.

schema.title: Response Create Runs Api V1 Runs Post

get.description: List historical evaluation runs with pagination and filters.
Retrieve top-level run execution summary, verdict, and metadata.
Retrieve full step-by-step tool invocation trace with highlighted vectors.

schema.title: Response Get Run Trace Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Trace Get

get.description: Retrieve PRE and POST environment snapshots for state diff verification.
Retrieve causal attack graph connecting attack vector to exploit effect.

post.description: Deterministically re-verify environment state diff predicates and canary tokens.
Cancel an active or queued run.
Queue a deterministic replay of a previous run under identical initial conditions.

schema.title: Response Replay Run Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Replay Post

post.description: Launch a multi-session sleeper evaluation (Plant -> Gap -> Trigger).

get.description: List cross-session sleeper test runs and their outcomes.
Retrieve multi-session lifecycle data and persistent memory diffs.

post.description: Launch an autonomous mutation campaign to discover novel exploit variants.

get.description: List autonomous discovery campaigns.
Retrieve discovery campaign progress, mutations tried, and breakthroughs.
List deduplicated vulnerability findings with severity filters.
Retrieve details, carrier traces, and causal attribution for a finding.

patch.description: Update status (open, acknowledged, fixed, dismissed) or notes on a finding.

get.description: Retrieve multi-finding aggregated attack graph across all evaluated scenarios.

post.description: Trigger a permission attribution audit comparing granted vs needed tools.

get.description: List permission attribution audit jobs.
Retrieve full attribution breakdown, excess tools, and proof of utility.
List candidate policy fixes suggested by the audit findings.

schema.title: Response List Fix Suggestions Api V1 Audits  Audit Id  Fixes Get

post.description: Queue parallel price tag evaluation for all suggested fixes.

schema.title: Response Evaluate All Fixes Api V1 Audits  Audit Id  Fixes Evaluate All Post

post.description: Queue empirical evaluation of a proposed fix across attacks and benign tasks.

get.description: List fix evaluations with two-dimensional price tags and Pareto statuses.
Retrieve detailed results, blocked cases, and broken tasks for a fix evaluation.

post.description: Trigger a fresh retest of the evaluated mitigation.
Generate and activate the child hardened security policy derived from this fix.

get.description: Return high-level security metrics, severity breakdown, and recent runs.

post.description: Generate a reproducible evidence report for an evaluation run.

get.description: List historical evidence reports.
Retrieve full markdown and cryptographic metadata for a report.
Download the evidence report file in Markdown format.

post.description: Launch the 1-minute live demo scan across attack scenarios.

get.description: Poll live execution status for an active demo scan.
